name: Langry RH225-B Integrated Digital Rebound Hammer
short_description: Advanced patented digital concrete hammer featuring non-contact electromagnetic sensor technology, integrated 2.8" OLED display, voice prompt reporting, and 1,000 component memory.
description: The **Langry RH225-B Integrated Digital Rebound Hammer** combines mechanical rebound precision with digital data capture. Designed for rapid evaluation of compressive strength in concrete structures, it eliminates human reading errors through a contactless metal grating sensor. Measurements are displayed instantly on a 2.8-inch high-contrast OLED screen, broadcast via human voice prompts, and logged into onboard memory with Bluetooth field printing capability.

key_features.feature: Patented integrated design: mechanical pointer and digital sensor in one housing
High-contrast 2.8-inch OLED dot matrix display (256x64 resolution)
Multi-language voice broadcast prompts for hands-free site operation
Massive internal storage: logs 1,000 test components and over 100,000 measurement points
Built-in Bluetooth communication for wireless on-site thermal printers
Long-life 3.7V / 3200 mAh rechargeable lithium-ion battery (over 10 hours continuous operation)
